hero_subhead: Seats up to 100 under a 16-foot video wall, then opens into the Lobby Bar for cocktails with up to 140. One room for the show, the speech and the party after.
band_intro: The Theatre is the heart of Den 1880's event floor: elevated bleacher seating, a 16-foot video wall, wireless mics and Sonos sound, with flexible furniture and customizable lighting to set the mood. When the formal part ends, the room opens straight into the Lobby Bar.
spec_subhead: Everything below is part of the room, not a rental add-on you chase down.
cta_headline: Put Your Event On The Stage
cta_subhead: Tell us your date and what you're hosting. Our events team replies within one business day with availability and a custom quote.
